basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old software developer living in Austin, TX. I recently took up biking as a hobby and have been exploring local trails and commuting to work by bike. Aside from biking, I'm into 3D modeling and am trying to learn more about it through online courses. I’m usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people through various activities and online communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and work in software development. My knowledge in biking is quite new, mostly gained from personal experiences and conversations with more seasoned cyclists. I'm also self-teaching myself 3D modeling through online platforms and community forums.
